postHocDiscrepancies.detail: That session's final report stated TWELVE workstreams. Twelve was the count of ws/* remote refs, not of logical workstreams — the substitution RULING 190 forbids and RULING 194 now names. The true figures, reconstructed from preserved refs rather than asserted: 13 LOGICAL WORKSTREAMS across 12 ws/* EXECUTION ARTIFACTS plus one integration branch. They differ in both directions at once, which is why neither number can stand in for the other: governance-orchestration ran on the integration branch and owns NO ws/* ref, while nine other workstreams own two artifacts each (a branch and its worktree). Ten were declared in this plan when the session ran; three were declared post hoc, here, on the evidence each entry carries.
